_comment: Edit this file, then run `uv run python scripts/setup.py`. Defaults reproduce the paper's main runs (Qwen 3.8 27B on a local llama.cpp server). See README.md.

pi._comment: Your own pi install. package_dir is the installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent package; agent_dir holds your pi auth and settings (only read, never changed).

model._comment: kind 'openai-completions': a server pi reaches through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama.cpp, vLLM, ...); the setup writes a full model entry. kind 'builtin': a provider pi already knows (e.g. openai-codex); the setup only overrides the declared context window. A builtin provider gets no sampling control.

extensions._comment: Cloned from their repositories by scripts/setup.py into vendor/repos/ and checked out at these commits. The defaults are the exact versions the paper ran: verbatim 6b970d3 (the pinned release) and pi-vcc fd2603e (0.8.12). Set a newer commit (or a branch) to test another version.

study1._comment: Study 1: 18 generated sessions (materials/scenarios/s1.json), 3 compaction rounds, planted-fact probes, rule-based scoring. No external data needed.

study4._comment: Study 4: commitment probes on 18 real pi sessions (downloaded by scripts/download_sessions.py). Probe turns only; 3 repetitions with these seeds.

judge._comment: Blind judge for Study 4 replies: any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. The default is Claude Sonnet through Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, the judge family our runs used. The API key is read from the environment variable named here.
